svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 07: Panels & Dialogue
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Bubble: [Oval] [Box] [Thought] Text Font v Size Align Colour
Selected panel: full editor. Others render read-only.
Who's there? Is it you, An|
Double-click a bubble or caption to edit its text.
The Text tool places a free caption (Task 7.11).
Fonts come from the approved Google Fonts list
That file type isn't supported. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
The image is larger than 5 MB.
Couldn't upload the image. Try again.
400 INVALID_FILE_TYPE (checked by the file's first bytes),
Its drawing and pictures are removed.
Up and Down reorder panels: renumbered 1, 2, 3 ...
Deleting a reference first removes its image shapes
from the drawing, then saves (Issue #10, S7 (iii)).
too many requests (429), quota used up (429),
One panel or moment at a time; up to 3 versions
of the dialogue for that moment, not 3 lines
The remaining daily count is shown after each
The panel strip becomes a horizontal row of
Reference images and the dialogue helper open as
The bubble toolbar wraps onto two rows.
Issue #17 D4: no panel layout or template picker;
Uploads: one file, PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most
Dialogue: one panel or moment, up to 3 versions
